copy.headline: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Eyes $270M Opening as ‘Dune: Part Three’ Also Heads for Big Start
copy.caption:
Dunesday is living up to the expectation as the high-profile features hit tracking. Dunesday excitement is prepared to reach a fever pitch as Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three hit tracking services ahead of their shared release date.

Marvel Studios ‘ Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for a massive box office opening of $270 million, marking NRG’s highest starting point ever. Disney releases directors Anthony Russo and Joe Russo’s film on Dec. 18, which is the same day that Warner Bros.’ similarly anticipated Dune: Part Three will hit theaters.

story.summary: Dunesday is living up to the expectation as the high-profile features hit tracking. Logo text Dunesday excitement is prepared to reach a fever pitch as Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three hit tracking services ahead of their shared release date. Marvel Studios ‘ Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for a massive box office opening of $270 million, marking NRG’s highest starting point ever. Disney releases directors Anthony Russo and Joe Russo’s film on Dec. 18, which is the same day that Warner Bros.’ similarly anticipated Dune: Part Three will hit theaters. As it stands, this launch would mark the strongest domestic opening for December, surpassing 2021’s $260 million start for fellow MCU title Spider-Man: No Way Home .
